summary: This directory serves as the root entry point and foundational utility layer, exposing core type definitions, normalization utilities, and shared schema-related interfaces that underpin the application's domain logic, data modeling, and analysis capabilities.
responsibilities: Export public API surfaces for domain-specific modules
Provide foundational type transformations for objects and configurations
Supply utility functions for data normalization and object manipulation
Define core architectural types used across system sub-domains
relationships: The directory provides foundational types that are imported by domain-specific modules to enforce consistent data structures.
Normalization utilities consume configuration interfaces to refine and standardize object properties before further processing.
The directory acts as a central aggregator, re-exporting symbols from specialized sub-directories to provide a unified interface for consumers.
designDecisions: Barrel file pattern for centralized and simplified module exports
Use of TypeScript mapped types for recursive object manipulation
Nominal typing strategy for path and identifier primitives
Separation of utility logic from core domain business services
